items.title: EU 'Digital Fairness Act' Could Have A Huge Impact On Loot Boxes And Virtual Currency
items.zh_title: 欧盟《数字公平法案》或将重创开箱与虚拟货币

items.title: Report: PlayStation's Fairgames cancelled, no devs to be laid off
